leaderboard_comparison_dated_2026_08_07.qcr_vs_rank2_duct_consistency: The rank-2 entry (Wu & Zhang) runs SST-QCRC, which carries the same untrained QCR2000 term. Our three QCR duct scores land within 0.0004 of theirs on all three ducts (0.0455 vs 0.0455, 0.0400 vs 0.0399, 0.0353 vs 0.0350) - independent solves, same constitutive term, same answer. The duct signal is the QCR term itself, and the campaign's route arithmetic (match rank 2's ducts, keep our board, take rank 1) is measured, not modelled.

what_the_result_confirms: The route's claim was structural: an untrained in-PDE term has no training range, so round 4's Re_y-extrapolation failure mechanism cannot recur. Measured: the two Ret_360 ducts - exactly where round 4's extrapolation cost lived - improved by -0.0356 and -0.0375, while AR_14 (inside the old trained range, where round 4 was already nearly optimal) gave back +0.0029. Improvement concentrated where the mechanism said it would, on a term with nothing fitted to anything.
